question: Why are some milk and juice cartons difficult to recycle?
answer: The carton wall is three layers stuck together: paper, plastic and aluminium. Until recently these cartons were not recyclable, and some plants have only lately been equipped to take them. So recyclability depends on the plants as well as the material.
move: Our reading: “recyclable” isn't settled by the material alone.
